# A deck plank (generated by make_env.py): 3.2 m along +X from the origin, 0.22 thick, 1.2 wide (the road).
new
material new Plank --base-color 0.620 0.502 0.361 --no-slot
material new PlankEdge --base-color 0.404 0.322 0.224 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Plank --size 1 --location 1.600 0.000 0.000
scale 3.2 1.2 0.22
apply --scale
material assign Plank
active Plank
mode edit
select face where "normal.y < -0.5 || abs(normal.x) > 0.5"
material assign PlankEdge
select face where "normal.y > 0.5 || normal.z < -0.5"
delete face
mode object
select all
shade flat
export plank.glb
